description: This file contains unit tests for the VerhoeffIdentifierValidator class, focusing on validation logic for identifiers, including check digit calculations and input validation scenarios.

classes.name: VerhoeffIdentifierValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the functionality of VerhoeffIdentifierValidator, ensuring correctness of identifier validation, check digit computation, and handling of invalid inputs.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier_shouldGetValidIdentifier
methods.description: Tests if the validator correctly appends and returns the check digit for a set of valid identifiers.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier_shouldFailWithInvalidIdentifiers
methods.description: Ensures that the validator throws exceptions when provided invalid identifier inputs.

methods.name: isValid_shouldFailWithInvalidIdentifiers
methods.description: Verifies that the isValid method throws exceptions for invalid identifiers.

methods.name: isValid_shouldFailWithInvalidSuffixes
methods.description: Checks that identifiers with incorrect suffixes are rejected by the isValid method.

methods.name: isValid_shouldPassWithValidSuffixes
methods.description: Validates that correctly suffixed identifiers are accepted by the isValid method.

methods.name: isValid_shouldFailWithIncorrectlyCalculatedSuffixes
methods.description: Ensures that identifiers with incorrect check digits suffixes are rejected.

methods.name: isValid_shouldFailWithNumericSuffixes
methods.description: Checks that numeric check digit suffixes provided where not allowed cause exceptions.

methods.name: checkDigit_shouldChangeWhenAdjacentCharsAreTransposed
methods.description: Tests that transposing adjacent characters in the identifier results in a different check digit, thus validating the robustness of the check digit calculation.
